limitations: This supplies descriptive context without a static-ability or continuous-effect evaluator.
rules.paraphrase: An object's static ability can be the origin of a continuous effect.

limitations: No effect evaluation, object selection, layer calculation, or dependency ordering is implemented.
rules.paraphrase: A static ability's continuous effect applies according to its text as circumstances change, rather than selecting one permanently fixed initial collection of objects.
rules.topic: Dynamic applicability of a static continuous effect

limitations: Location-sensitive effects, static abilities, and duration tracking remain unsupported.
rules.paraphrase: The generating permanent's presence on the battlefield, or the generating object's presence in the applicable zone, ordinarily sustains the effect's applicability.
rules.topic: Ordinary location condition for a static continuous effect

limitations: Only the special relationship relevant to the existing 400.7b evidence is described.
No land permission, casting, continuous effect, battlefield ability, or duration runtime is supplied.
rules.paraphrase: A static effect that supplies land-play access, permanent-spell casting access, or a granted casting ability can also supply an ability usable only on the battlefield. That battlefield ability persists for the duration given by the access-granting effect, or through the game's end when no duration is given, departing from the ordinary dynamic and location conditions.
rules.topic: Special duration of a battlefield ability granted with play or casting access

limitations: The condition and destination are evidence only; Aura legality and all state-action execution remain absent.
No numbered dependency is inferred from the state-action subsystem boundaries.
rules.paraphrase: An Aura attached to an impermissible object or player, or attached to neither, is moved into the graveyard belonging to its owner.
rules.topic: Aura state action for an invalid or absent attachment

limitations: Both linked abilities are described, with no discard, replacement, exile, trigger, casting, cost, or movement runtime.
rules.paraphrase: Madness packages two abilities: a static ability available from hand redirects a discard's destination to exile, then a triggered ability that functions when that replacement applies lets the owner cast the card for its madness cost instead of its mana cost. Declining that casting sends the card to the owner's graveyard.
rules.topic: Madness as a linked discard replacement and casting trigger

limitations: All four casting references remain unresolved and unprojected.
No rule 601 content, casting operation, alternative-cost evaluator, or payment operation is supplied.
rules.paraphrase: Casting by means of madness uses the alternative-cost casting procedure identified by four specific casting subrules, whose content is outside this projection.

limitations: The existing 400.7k record is linked without being re-projected.
Represented lookup relationships do not supply Madness or object-history execution.
rules.paraphrase: After the madness trigger has finished, if the card in exile was left uncast and moved to a public zone, an effect referring to the discarded card may locate the resulting object.

limitations: The existing 400.7 record is linked without duplication; no sticker or zone runtime is supplied.
rules.paraphrase: An object's stickers cease to accompany it upon a hidden-zone move. A public-zone move carries the stickers to the resulting object, where their effects remain applicable, as a stated exception to the ordinary new-object rule.
rules.topic: Sticker retention depends on destination visibility

limitations: Meld composition and timestamp execution remain unsupported.
No numbered meld rule is inferred or projected.
rules.paraphrase: When sticker-bearing cards enter the battlefield within a melded permanent, their stickers are carried onto that permanent while preserving the stickers' relative timestamp ordering.
rules.topic: Sticker combination on a melded permanent

limitations: Merge composition is distinct from the selected meld case and remains unsupported.
No numbered merge rule is inferred or projected.
rules.paraphrase: A sticker belonging to an object that becomes a component of a merged battlefield permanent is carried by that merged permanent.
rules.topic: Sticker transfer into a merged permanent

limitations: Retention is bounded to one chosen result, rather than every resulting object.
No meld, merge, choice, zone movement, or sticker-effect execution is supplied.
rules.paraphrase: When a sticker-bearing melded or merged permanent leaves the battlefield for another public zone, its owner selects one resulting object to carry its stickers. Only that selected object continues to receive those stickers' effects, even when the departure produces multiple objects.
rules.topic: One owner-selected resulting object keeps departing composite stickers
